newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to open tender for coastal gas network.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to open tender for coastal gas network.

text.p: Croatia will invite foreign and local companies to tender for a gas network in coastal towns including Split, the state news agency Hina reported.
Representatives of state gas board Zagrebacka plinara signed a contract on Thursday with Split county authorities to draw up a plan which will serve as the basis for the 20-to-30-year concessions.
"We expect the plan will soon be completed and the first gas-pipes installed by the end of next year," Frane Matejcic of Zagrebacka plinara told Hina.
The gas board said gas was three to five times cheaper than electricity and would be useful for running much needed extensive air-conditioning systems during the tourist season.
The plan includes the smaller towns of Trogir, Solin and Kastela around Split.
